title: Sordland/Turn04/Personal_LucianChessMatch
description: During one late evening, Lucian offers to play chess. Anton can win/lose but also discover a little bit about the past of Lucian Galade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evening descended on the capital as..."
entries.dialogueText: Evening descended on the capital as Lucian and I found ourselves alone in my office. I followed my chief strategist's eyes to the chessboard on the coffee table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sight of it reminded me of simp..."
entries.dialogueText: The sight of it reminded me of simpler times, of late-night strategy sessions turning into chess matches. We used to escape the political chaos into a world of rooks and bishops.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our battles were both tense and fri..."
entries.dialogueText: Our battles were both tense and friendly, a reflection of our long history together. Lucian had always proved a challenging opponent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His strategies, both on the chessbo..."
entries.dialogueText: His strategies, both on the chessboard and in politics, had the same unpredictable edge.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: A soft knock interrupted my reminiscing.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Long nights of strategy planning,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Long nights of strategy planning, and now a game of chess. You two never stop thinking, do you?"

entries.title: Narrator: "Livia came in with our usual coffee..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia came in with our usual coffee. She noticed the chessboard and smiled.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Have a good game, gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good game, gentlemen."

entries.dialogueText: "Neither of them hold any real power, Lucian. It's the player who controls them."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "The power dynamics of a chess board can teach us a lot about politics, wouldn't you agree, Lucian?"

entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, sir, even the most strategic pawn move won't help if you overlook the other pieces."

entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. But a wise player recognizes the value of every piece on the board."

entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely. And playing chess with politicians will tell you more about their goals and plans than any speech."

entries.dialogueText: His dexterous maneuvering reflected the unseen orchestration that helped Petr and me ascend through the ranks.

entries.dialogueText: "You're beginning to intrigue me, Lucian. What are you not telling me?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Can you tell me more about this... different capacity you served in?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I certainly don't wish to delve in..."

entries.dialogueText: "I've reconciled with my past, sir. I don't shy away from sharing aspects of it with those I trust."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It was a complex dance, rife with..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a complex dance, rife with deception and shadows."

entries.dialogueText: "Let's just say I was one of many who had to navigate those treacherous waters."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We've known each other for years,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've known each other for years, and that's all I get?"

entries.dialogueText: "Treacherous waters... were you a naval officer?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I certainly don't wish to delve in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I certainly don't wish to delve into matters that might unsettle you."

entries.dialogueText: "What sort of conflicts are we talking about?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Caught in the crossfire... were you in the military?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It is not my intent to withhold in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not my intent to withhold information from you. But I believe we should focus on the future of Sordland, and leave its history where it belongs."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's a discussion for another day,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a discussion for another day, Mr. President. Suffice to say, it was a time when Sordland was a battleground of older ideals and ambitions."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""My role? Let's just say I was one..."
entries.dialogueText: "My role? Let's just say I was one of the pieces on the board."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I've reconciled with my past and s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've reconciled with my past and set it aside."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So you were a spy? Sounds fascinat..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you were a spy? Sounds fascinating."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Cut the metaphors, Lucian. I want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cut the metaphors, Lucian. I want details."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You were involved in intelligence..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were involved in intelligence work, Lucian? That's certainly an unexpected revelation."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's true, sir. During the late Ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true, sir. During the late Kingdom era, I found myself part of King Egmund's intelligence service."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In a manner many would find... obj..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a manner many would find... objectionable."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""There's much I still cannot say. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's much I still cannot say. But I carried out some unconventional assignments for King Egmund."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I served in a capacity that often..."
entries.dialogueText: "I served in a capacity that often demanded... morally challenging choices."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""'Spy' is a simplistic term, Mr. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Spy' is a simplistic term, Mr. President. My past roles were, let's say, less than conventional."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I served for the national interest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I served for the national interests of King Egmund."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Much as I'd love to elaborate, I m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Much as I'd love to elaborate, I must take my leave. Thank you for the delightful match."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""On that note, it's time for me to..."
entries.dialogueText: "On that note, it's time for me to depart. I thoroughly enjoyed our match tonight, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's always a pleasure to witness..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's always a pleasure to witness your strategic prowess."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Delightful for you, maybe. I deman..."
entries.dialogueText: "Delightful for you, maybe. I demand a rematch."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Lucian. The match was i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Lucian. The match was indeed captivating."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's very gracious of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very gracious of you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As did I. The game was as enlighte..."
entries.dialogueText: "As did I. The game was as enlightening as it was entertaining."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Indeed, the game was a great pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, the game was a great pleasure, Lucian. Safe travels home."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I hope to play again soon. Though..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope to play again soon. Though I cannot promise the outcome will be any different for you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Win or lose, there's always someth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Win or lose, there's always something to be learned from a round of chess."

entries.dialogueText: As Lucian exited the room, the memories of our game lingered, as did the enigmatic aura of the man himself.
